fullDescription:
**Your Photo or Name, Made to Order.**

Personalize a slim silicone phone case with your own photo, name, or initials — UV-printed or laser-engraved to your specification.

**Design & Build (verifiable structure):**
- **Silicone outer layer with PC support** — a flexible silicone feel over a structured shell (final structure confirmed per supplier and phone model).
- **Raised screen & camera edges** to keep the screen and lenses off flat surfaces.
- **Covered, easy-press buttons** instead of open cutouts.
- **Reinforced corner design.**
- **Made to order** with your photo, name, or initials (UV print / laser engraving).

**How It Works:**
1. Pick your phone model.
2. Upload a photo or enter your name / initials and approve the proof.
3. We make it to order. Production: 7-12 business days; estimated delivery varies by destination after shipment.

**Returns (summary — full terms confirmed in your written quote before payment):**
Made-to-order items are eligible for replacement/refund for **defects, production errors, or items materially different from your approved proof**, verified by photos of the item received. Customer-side mistakes (wrong text entered, low-resolution photo, change of mind) are not covered. The exact claim window, required evidence, and who pays return shipping are stated in the written quote or invoice you approve before payment. This site has no automated checkout.

**Note on images:** Product images are **digital renders for design preview only — not production photos**. Final color, texture, camera cutout, and print placement may vary by phone model and approved artwork.

**Specifications:**
- **Material:** Liquid silicone outer + hard PC support (per supplier/model)
- **Fits:** Current iPhone & Samsung flagship models
- **Production Time:** 7-12 business days (production only)
- **Price:** $19.90 base price — personalization included; shipping, taxes, and phone-model-specific changes confirmed in your written quote before payment

Request a personalized case made to your design.
